_comment: Machine-readable lockfile of the PURE-PYTHON pip deps that the auto-updater may install into an installed app without a full rebuild. This is the source of truth for gen_manifest.py's pip_installs diff. Compiled/heavy deps (torch, torchaudio, demucs, madmom, faster-whisper, PyGObject, pycairo) are NOT listed here — changing them requires a full release. Keep in sync when adding a pure dep the app imports at runtime.
